Dustline

Five against five with four bot teammates on a desert town, a container harbor or a snowed-in village. Terrorists plant the bomb on site A or B, Counter-Terrorists stop them or defuse it. First to seven rounds wins.

This game needs a keyboard and mouse.

Controls

W A S D
Move. Tap the opposite key to stop dead before you shoot
Mouse
Aim and shoot. Hold to spray, tap for accuracy
Shift / C
Walk quietly / crouch, both steady your aim
Space
Jump
R
Reload
B
Buy menu, in your spawn at the start of a round
1 2 3 4, Q
Main gun, pistol, knife, grenades (4 cycles them), last used
Grenade
Hold left to pull the pin, let go to throw. Right mouse lobs it short
Knife
Left slashes, right stabs. Hits in the back hurt far more
E
Hold to plant or defuse the bomb. Swap for a gun on the ground
G
Drop your gun, or the bomb with the knife or a grenade out
M
Full map: sites, teammates, spotted enemies, the bomb, dropped guns
Right mouse
AWP scope, two zoom levels
F
Inspect your gun
Tab
Scoreboard. Dead? Click to watch the next teammate
Esc
Pause menu (settings, controls)
